## Setup

Coding agent, client version, plugin version, OS, and installation method:

## First debrief

Could you install, find the action, and finish a Change Debrief? Where did you get stuck?

## What became clearer?

One thing you could explain afterward, or what remained confusing. A fictional example is enough.

## Would you use it again?

Why or why not? If you already used it on a different task, say so. Intention alone is not repeat use.

## Optional follow-up

- [ ] The maintainer may ask one follow-up question in this public issue after about a week.

This issue is public. Do not attach project source, private records, secrets, complete logs, contact information, or employer details. See the [privacy guidance](https://github.com/parkyountaek/own-the-change/blob/main/docs/protocol/understanding-protocol.md#privacy-and-safety). Leaving feedback does not authorize quoting you in marketing.
